en.focusLock.setup.title: Set up Salah focus

en.focusLock.setup.explain.body1: When a Salah window starts, the apps you choose are paused until you pray or the window ends.

en.focusLock.setup.perm.overlayHint: Shows the Salah screen on top of a paused app.

en.focusLock.evidence.heedless: A warning to those heedless of their Salah — Qur'an 107:4–5
